subject: integration
name: uBlock Origin
summary: uBlock Origin, the content blocker Orivon installs into a new profile, pinned to one release. Open source (GPL-3.0) and it runs only its pinned code. It is 3, not 4: it acts on every page, and it downloads filter lists from servers nothing checks, so what it blocks follows lists others publish, and those servers see this computer's address. Judged here by its publisher.
